title: AI Assistant for Marketing & Sales Support Automation
description: An AI assistant built to automate meeting summaries, follow-ups, and pipeline reporting across Microsoft 365 and Notion workflows.

highlights.label: captured meeting decisions and action items automatically after client calls
accelerated follow-up cycles across marketing and sales workflows
saved weekly per person by reducing manual tracking and reporting tasks

client_text: A B2B marketing and sales team managing dozens of Teams meetings, emails, shared documents, and chat threads every week. The team needed a structured AI-powered system to capture decisions, assign follow-ups, and create reliable visibility into sales and marketing activity.
product_text: The AI Marketing & Sales Assistant is an automation system designed to turn meetings, emails, and documents into structured actions, reports, and pipeline insights.
product_list: Capture meeting summaries, decisions, and action items automatically
Track ownership, follow-ups, and pipeline updates in Notion
Generate weekly AI-powered reports for marketing and sales leadership
product_text_2: The solution was built to reduce missed follow-ups, improve pipeline visibility, and give teams a single source of truth for ongoing marketing and sales activity.
goals: The client needed to replace scattered manual tracking with a centralized automation workflow that could capture decisions, organize action items, and keep stakeholders aligned. The main goal was to reduce operational noise, improve follow-up discipline, and create structured reporting without forcing the team to change its existing Microsoft 365 workflow.
challenges:
▪ Meeting decisions and action items were not captured automatically, which caused follow-ups to be missed or delayed.

▪ Sales pipeline visibility depended on individual memory, manual updates, and information scattered across several tools.

▪ Reporting on marketing activity and sales progress required too much manual effort and lacked a consistent structure.
solution:
AltheraCode designed a modular AI automation system connected to the client’s Microsoft 365 environment. The system collected data from Teams meetings, Office 365 emails, chat threads, Word/PDF documents, and other shared sources, then transformed unstructured information into organized action records.

The workflow used N8N automation, Microsoft Graph API, OpenAI-powered extraction, and a Notion workspace as the central command center. Meeting summaries, decisions, owners, deadlines, pipeline updates, and alerts were automatically structured and routed to the right stakeholders.
results_text: The implementation improved meeting accountability, follow-up speed, and sales pipeline visibility across the team. Key outcomes included:

results.label: of key meeting decisions captured automatically after client discussions
faster follow-up cycle from agreement to responsible owner action
saved weekly per person by reducing manual reporting and scattered tracking

results_closing: A fragmented marketing and sales workflow was transformed into a centralized AI-assisted operating system that improved execution, reduced missed actions, and gave leadership clearer visibility into pipeline activity.
